'''Vincė Vaidevutė Margevičienė''' (born 12 May 1949) is a [[Lithuania]]n biologist, political prisoner, politician and a former member of the [[Seimas]].<ref>{{Cite news |url=http://www.15min.lt/naujiena/aktualu/lietuva/seimo-nare-vince-vaidevute-margeviciene-pamazu-sveiksta-56-338539 |title=Seimo narė Vincė Vaidevutė Margevičienė pamažu sveiksta |trans-title=MP Vince Vaidevute Margevičienė slowly recovering |last=Želnienė |first=Liepa |website=[[15 min]] |language=Lithuanian |date=24 May 2013 |access-date=9 December 2016}}</ref> She was designated as the vice chairwoman of the [[Homeland Union]] in 2015.
